ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level dominance of low-intensity black pixels with sparse (estimated <5%) high-intensity white pixel localized clusters and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the core surface area; high-contrast contiguous white blobs are localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes; multiple vertical high-intensity linear streaks are present in the mid-ventral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct central V-shaped notch with an acute angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the transverse axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and deep valleys along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe boundaries exhibit a convex curve sweeping posteriorly and laterally toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups concentrated at the extreme lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, non-parallel vertical white linear pixel disruptions breaking the dark pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-contrast white textured clusters at the tips of both lobes and multiple vertical linear scratches across the ventral surface.
